base: c999431 plus rejected-prefix, bounded-drain, same-turn-handoff, cap64 and ACK-pruning experiments

notes: Temporary exact phase and grant transit instrumentation. Experimental cap64 is not production policy.
Two consecutive 21 Gbit/s requested points, 10 seconds each; daemons retained within each pair.
No builds or other tests overlap measurement. Phase totals include the before/after drain interval.
Phase duration is charged on every transition, with the current interval included at snapshot. Older sampled-state phase_ns attribution is not an exact duration and must not be used instead.

Grant timings count successful-prefix completions: issuance to pre-send timestamp, then pre-send to fresh owner receipt. The latter includes the syscall and completion handoff, not just queue latency.
Open includes pacing waits and worker flight/request transit; it does not establish unconstrained sender capacity.
This diagnostic clone predates the production loss-before-PTO barrier. Results are experiments, not normal-build acceptance tests.

Earlier notification adds a bounded sender flush and notification flush at service_sender exit. It is not adopted: two short points do not show a consistent bidirectional throughput gain, and syscall cost is not separately measured.
